charge_value_conserved.name: charge_value_conserved
charge_value_conserved.value: (amount_atoms = ((funded_atoms + debt_atoms) + debt_refunded_atoms)) AND (refunded_atoms >= debt_refunded_atoms) AND ((refunded_atoms - debt_refunded_atoms) <= funded_atoms)

resource_opaque_identity.name: resource_opaque_identity
resource_opaque_identity.value: length(remote_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND remote_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_:/.-]+$' AND remote_id !~ '://' AND remote_id !~ '(^|/)[.]{1,2}(/|$)'

resource_batch_metadata.name: resource_batch_metadata
resource_batch_metadata.value: batch_manifest IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(batch_manifest)='object' AND batch_manifest-ARRAY['items','idsSha256','images']='{}'::jsonb AND batch_manifest ?& ARRAY['items','idsSha256'] AND jsonb_typeof(batch_manifest->'items')='number' AND batch_manifest->>'items' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$' AND (batch_manifest->>'items')::numeric<=9007199254740991 AND jsonb_typeof(batch_manifest->'idsSha256')='string' AND batch_manifest->>'idsSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND (NOT batch_manifest?'images' OR jsonb_typeof(batch_manifest->'images')='number' AND batch_manifest->>'images' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$' AND (batch_manifest->>'images')::numeric<=9007199254740991)) IS TRUE

usage_conflict_core_links.name: usage_conflict_core_links
usage_conflict_core_links.value: (incoming_evidence_id IS NULL AND disputed_evidence_id IS NULL AND incoming_receipt_id IS NULL) OR (incoming_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND disputed_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND incoming_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)

usage_record_kind.name: usage_record_kind
usage_record_kind.value:
record_kind IN ('GATEWAY','RAW','CANONICAL','DISPUTED') AND CASE record_kind
        WHEN 'GATEWAY' THEN cost_atoms IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_revision IS NULL AND snapshot_digest IS NULL AND final_dimensions IS NULL AND parent_evidence_id IS NULL AND input_fact_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'RAW' THEN cost_atoms IS NULL AND NOT cost_complete AND snapshot_revision>=1 AND snapshot_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND final_dimensions IS NOT NULL AND parent_evidence_id IS NULL AND input_fact_id IS NULL
        WHEN 'CANONICAL' THEN cost_atoms IS NOT NULL AND snapshot_revision>=1 AND snapshot_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND final_dimensions IS NOT NULL AND input_fact_id IS NOT NULL
        ELSE snapshot_revision>=1 AND snapshot_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND final_dimensions IS NOT NULL AND input_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND (cost_atoms IS NOT NULL OR NOT cost_complete) END

core_receipt_source.name: core_receipt_source
core_receipt_source.value: source IN ('execution','execution_outcome','recovery_interruption','async_partial','async_final','batch_completed','batch_cancelled','batch_failed','provider_invoice') AND source_revision>=1 AND body_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND origin_identity ~ '^gateway:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$'

core_receipt_outcome.name: core_receipt_outcome
core_receipt_outcome.value:
outcome IN ('ACCEPTED','STALE','ESTIMATED','REVISION_REPLAY','CONFLICT','OVERFLOW','QUARANTINED') AND finality IN ('FINAL','PARTIAL','UNKNOWN','ESTIMATED','NOT_EXECUTED')
        AND (outcome<>'CONFLICT' OR (conflict_id IS NOT NULL AND disputed_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT revision_claim))
        AND (outcome<>'OVERFLOW' OR (numeric_fault='COST_OVERFLOW' AND disputed_evidence_id IS NOT NULL))
        AND (outcome NOT IN ('ACCEPTED','REVISION_REPLAY') OR (canonical_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND disputed_evidence_id IS NULL AND conflict_id IS NULL))
        AND (numeric_fault IS NULL OR numeric_fault='COST_OVERFLOW')
        AND (attempt_state IS NULL OR attempt_state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN','PARTIAL','NOT_EXECUTED'))
        AND (request_state IS NULL OR request_state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','UNKNOWN'))
        AND (error_code IS NULL OR error_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,79}$')
        AND (provider_request_id IS NULL OR provider_request_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,256}$')
        AND cardinality(risk_dimensions)<=16

core_receipt_authentication.name: core_receipt_authentication
core_receipt_authentication.value:
authentication_disposition IN ('VERIFIED','QUARANTINED') AND authentication_reason IN ('NORMAL','SECURITY_REVOKED','UNGRANTED')
        AND (authentication_disposition='VERIFIED')=(authentication_reason='NORMAL')
        AND (authentication_disposition='QUARANTINED')=(outcome='QUARANTINED')
        AND (outcome<>'QUARANTINED' OR (canonical_evidence_id IS NULL AND disputed_evidence_id IS NULL AND conflict_id IS NULL AND NOT revision_claim AND cardinality(risk_dimensions)=0))
        AND producer_key_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND signature_version=1 AND octet_length(signature)=64 AND signature_payload_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

upstream_funding_currency.name: upstream_funding_currency
upstream_funding_currency.value: credited_currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3,8}$' AND (payment_currency IS NULL OR payment_currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3,8}$')

upstream_recharge_fact.name: upstream_recharge_fact
upstream_recharge_fact.value: kind<>'RECHARGE' OR (payment_atoms IS NOT NULL AND payment_atoms>0 AND credited_atoms>0 AND voucher_id IS NOT NULL AND voucher_digest IS NOT NULL AND payment_currency IS NOT NULL)

upstream_hold_amounts.name: upstream_hold_amounts
upstream_hold_amounts.value: estimated_atoms>=0 AND (final_cost_atoms IS NULL OR final_cost_atoms>=0)

plugin_run_digests.name: plugin_run_digests
plugin_run_digests.value: fixture_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND policy_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND runtime_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND (result_digest IS NULL OR result_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

plugin_run_result.name: plugin_run_result
plugin_run_result.value: (result IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(result)='object' AND octet_length(result::text)<=4096)) AND (error_code IS NULL OR error_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,79}$')

identity_cert_shape.name: identity_cert_shape
identity_cert_shape.value: certificate_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND length(uri_san) BETWEEN 1 AND 250 AND length(subject_altname_exact) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND not_after>not_before AND authorization_revision>0

identity_instance_shape.name: identity_instance_shape
identity_instance_shape.value: service IN ('gateway','core-api','core-worker') AND instance_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$' AND authorization_revision>0

identity_instance_security.name: identity_instance_security
identity_instance_security.value: (security_revoked_at IS NULL AND security_reason IS NULL) OR (security_revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND security_reason='SECURITY_INCIDENT')

identity_registration_shape.name: identity_registration_shape
identity_registration_shape.value: octet_length(public_key_spki)=44 AND encode(sha256(public_key_spki),'hex')=public_key_sha256 AND octet_length(boot_nonce)=32 AND octet_length(server_nonce)=32 AND registration_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND audience ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}/core-api$'

identity_registration_state.name: identity_registration_state
identity_registration_state.value: (state='REGISTERED' AND session_id IS NOT NULL AND receipt IS NOT NULL) OR (state IN ('PENDING','EXPIRED') AND session_id IS NULL AND receipt IS NULL)

identity_session_shape.name: identity_session_shape
identity_session_shape.value: octet_length(public_key_spki)=44 AND encode(sha256(public_key_spki),'hex')=public_key_sha256 AND octet_length(boot_nonce)=32 AND expires_at>registered_at AND authorization_revision>0

public.money_journal.definition: SELECT i.id, i.wallet_id, i.reference, i.kind, i.currency, p.lines, i.created_at FROM money_entries i JOIN journal_payloads p ON p.id = i.id AND p.created_at = i.created_at
public.money_journal.name: money_journal

public.usage_events.definition: SELECT i.id, i.seq, i.project_id, i.request_id, i.attempt_id, i.source, i.finality, p.usage, i.cost_atoms, i.currency, i.created_at, i.cost_complete, i.record_kind, i.snapshot_revision, i.final_dimensions FROM usage_event_index i JOIN usage_payloads p ON p.id = i.id AND p.created_at = i.created_at WHERE i.record_kind <> 'RAW'
public.usage_events.name: usage_events
